title: ABM Microsite Examples for Enterprise Marketing Teams: Build Patterns That Drive Pipeline
theme: ABM Microsite Examples for Enterprise Marketing Teams
thesis: Enterprise marketing teams face credibility risk when ABM microsites feel generic or fail to engage buying groups. Effective ABM microsites require individual-level personalization, integration with intent data, and clear attribution to pipeline. Teams using AI-orchestrated dynamic experiences achieve 10x engagement and 50% faster campaign builds, according to Folloze customer data.
summary: The pressure is on. You have a list of 50 target accounts, a content library full of assets, and a mandate to prove that ABM drives pipeline. But every time you launch a microsite, it feels like a gamble. Will the content resonate with the buying committee? Will the sales team actually use it? That credibility risk is real.
key_takeaways: TL;DR: Enterprise marketing teams face credibility risk when ABM microsites feel generic or fail to engage buying groups.
Enterprise marketing teams struggle because the old campaign model is too slow, too dev-dependent, and too disconnected from revenue proof.
According to Folloze (2025), one marketer can run programs that used to require a team.
proof_points: Teams using AI-orchestrated dynamic experiences achieve 10x engagement and 50% faster campaign builds, according to Folloze customer data.
Folloze customers like Conga saw $6.3M attributed pipeline from six campaigns built on two boards.
Folloze's Campaign Agent enables 5x faster campaign creation by intelligently curating content.
RingCentral used this approach and achieved 98% target account engagement and 50% C-suite engagement in 60 days.
